name: {GAME} in Moscow
description: This paint was added to the game especially for the «{GAME} in the City» event that took place in Moscow on September 9th, 2017. The paint was also part of the special «{GAME} in Moscow» pack.
interestingFacts: This paint was received by all registered participants of the tank meeting in Moscow on September 9, 2017 in the form of a promotional code.
Also, the paint was available for purchase in the “{GAME} in Moscow” kit for 15.99 EUR from September 2 to September 11, 2017.
